neighbours.label: ' of' in 'out of the box' (and a few other fixed prepositional idioms that must continue with 'the', e.g. 'equal protection of the laws', 'years to the day'); output promotes ' the'
fire: The router supports mesh networking out of the box, so setup took minutes.
Most of these plugins do not work out of the box with the newer release.
I was surprised that the bike rode so well straight out of the box.
The framework handles logins and sessions out of the box for you.
The amendment guarantees every resident the equal protection of the laws.
The court held that the statute denied them the equal protection of the laws.
The drone flies well out of the box, though the manual is thin.
The headphones sounded balanced right out of the box, with no tuning needed.
quiet: The router supports mesh networking out of necessity, so setup took minutes.
Most of these plugins are out of date and fail with the newer release.
I was surprised that the bike rode so well straight from the shop.
The framework handles logins and sessions inside a box drawn on the diagram.
The amendment guarantees every resident a measure of protection from seizure.
The court held that the statute denied them a fair hearing on appeal.
The drone flies well outside the fence, though the manual is thin.
The headphones came in a box of recycled cardboard, with no plastic inside.

notes: Card: top examples are prepositions in idioms that continue with 'the' (out of the box, to the day, protection of the laws, behind the wheel, under the terms); logit effect promotes ' the'. Probes: out of the box .74 / .64, protection of the laws .40, to the day .17, behind the wheel .04 / .12, under the terms .05 / .11; out of curiosity .01, out of the room .04, out of the blue .08, off the shelf .01. So the idiom set is much narrower than 'preposition before the'.
